commits.subject: fix(pipeline-api): refuse a rediscovery/sourcing re-surface of a withheld person

rule: POST /api/pipeline refuses 409 PIPELINE_ADD_CANDIDATE_WITHHELD (+ withheld: opted_out|consent_expired|anonymized) before any write when source is a re-surface marker ('rediscovery' | 'sourcing', the same RESURFACE_SOURCES set that gates the prior link) and withheldCandidateIds withholds the person. A human add without that marker is filed unchanged.
why: docs/features/comms/README.md (candidate opt-out): an opt-out stops outreach and 'does not withdraw an application', so a blanket refusal would overreach

registry recruiting/candidate-consent-and-retention: re-contacting on a new opening is the pool purpose and runs on consent, so a lapsed consent removes the basis for re-surfacing, not for a human's deliberate filing
registry recruiting/candidate-outreach-and-halt-rules: the gates sit on the handoff from the candidate list to the first touch, and a re-surface add is that handoff

a comms-suppressed mark on the entry was unnecessary: commsSendSuppression already resolves the opt-out and consent at the durable candidate identity, so a human-filed entry still cannot be contacted (pinned in the test)
erasure was already refused for every caller inside createPipelineEntry
rejected_alternatives: refuse every add of a withheld person: contradicts the documented opt-out scope and blocks legitimate re-applications
allow and mark comms-suppressed: would duplicate the person-level send gate with a per-entry flag that could drift from it
red_first: add-eligibility.test.ts: 3 of 5 failed before the change (200 where 409 was expected); the 2 control cases passed
